# Change review

## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem and the resulting behavior or reader benefit.

## Completed issues

Add one real closing line per completed executable issue. Keep incomplete or
operational acceptance issues open and explain their relationship.

## Acceptance and evidence

Map each issue criterion to its document section, test, command, or observed result.
For behavior changes, record actual red/green and relevant refactoring checks.
For prose, record source/link/example/reader validation. State unavailable checks.

## Review and consequences

Record the separate review, findings and resolution. Explain relevant policy,
compatibility, migration, security, or recovery effects and remaining limits.

- [ ] The agreed scope is complete and follow-up work is tracked separately.
- [ ] Required checks pass on the current change; evidence claims match execution.
- [ ] A separate reviewer examined the final change and findings are resolved.
- [ ] Affected docs/examples are accurate and public content contains no private data.
